entryCopy.en-US: Call LEFT or RIGHT before each challenge toss. The catcher moves the paddle to that side with its blue side facing the ball. Toss straight and gently at that paddle. Only a catch on the paddle on the called side counts as correct. Take the ball off with the free hand and make a neutral return; it needs no call and does not count. Switch roles after the same caller’s 5 challenge tosses; returns are excluded.

steps: Before each challenge toss, the caller says “Left” or “Right.”
The catcher moves the paddle to that side of their own body, with the blue side facing the ball.
The caller tosses straight and gently toward that paddle, never toward the person’s body.
The catch counts as correct only if the ball sticks to the blue side on the called side.
The catcher takes the ball off with their free hand and makes a normal return pass. Returns need no call and do not count.
The same caller makes 5 challenge tosses, then you switch roles. Do not include return passes in those 5.
en-US.goal: Make 8 correct catches on the called side.
en-US.safety: Aim at the blue paddle face on the called side, never at the person. Keep tosses straight and gentle.
en-US.setup: 2 players, 2 paddles, 1 ball. Left and right mean the catcher’s own left and right.
